verses.original: כִּֽי־ יִקַּ֥ח אִ֛ישׁ אִשָּׁ֖ה וּבְעָלָ֑הּ וְהָיָ֞ה אִם־ לֹ֧א תִמְצָא־ חֵ֣ן בְּעֵינָ֗יו כִּי־ מָ֤צָא בָהּ֙ עֶרְוַ֣ת דָּבָ֔ר וְכָ֨תַב לָ֜הּ סֵ֤פֶר כְּרִיתֻת֙ וְנָתַ֣ן בְּיָדָ֔הּ וְשִׁלְּחָ֖הּ מִבֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yiq·qaḥ ’îš ’iš·šāh ū·ḇə·‘ā·lāh wə·hā·yāh ’im- lō ṯim·ṣā- ḥên bə·‘ê·nāw kî- mā·ṣā ḇāh ‘er·waṯ dā·ḇār wə·ḵā·ṯaḇ lāh sê·p̄er kə·rî·ṯuṯ wə·nā·ṯan bə·yā·ḏāh wə·šil·lə·ḥāh mib·bê·ṯōw
verses.literal: If . . . a man marries . . . a woman but she becomes displeasing . . . . . . . . . to him because he finds some indecency in her he may write her a certificate of divorce hand it to her and send her away from his house

verses.original: וְיָצְאָ֖ה מִבֵּית֑וֹ וְהָלְכָ֖ה וְהָיְתָ֥ה לְאִישׁ־ אַחֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ṣə·’āh mib·bê·ṯōw wə·hā·lə·ḵāh wə·hā·yə·ṯāh lə·’îš- ’a·ḥêr
verses.literal: If, after leaving his house she goes and becomes another man’s wife

verses.original: וּשְׂנֵאָהּ֮ הָאִ֣ישׁ הָאַחֲרוֹן֒ וְכָ֨תַב לָ֜הּ סֵ֤פֶר כְּרִיתֻת֙ וְנָתַ֣ן בְּיָדָ֔הּ וְשִׁלְּחָ֖הּ מִבֵּית֑וֹ א֣וֹ כִ֤י יָמוּת֙ הָאִ֣ישׁ הָאַחֲר֔וֹן אֲשֶׁר־ לְקָחָ֥הּ ל֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·śə·nê·’āh hā·’îš hā·’a·ḥă·rō·wn wə·ḵā·ṯaḇ lāh sê·p̄er kə·rî·ṯuṯ wə·nā·ṯan bə·yā·ḏāh wə·šil·lə·ḥāh mib·bê·ṯōw ’ōw ḵî yā·mūṯ hā·’îš hā·’a·ḥă·rō·wn ’ă·šer- lə·qā·ḥāh lōw lə·’iš·šāh
verses.literal: and the second man hates her writes her a certificate of divorce hands it to her and sends her away from his house or if he dies . . . . . . -

verses.original: לֹא־ יוּכַ֣ל בַּעְלָ֣הּ הָרִאשׁ֣וֹן אֲשֶֽׁר־ שִׁ֠לְּחָהּ לָשׁ֨וּב לְקַחְתָּ֜הּ לִהְי֧וֹת ל֣וֹ לְאִשָּׁ֗ה אַחֲרֵי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֻטַּמָּ֔אָה כִּֽי־ תוֹעֵבָ֥ה הִ֖וא לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹ֤א תַחֲטִיא֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ נַחֲלָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō- yū·ḵal ba‘·lāh hā·ri·šō·wn ’ă·še·rō·ši- šil·lə·ḥāh lā·šūḇ lə·qaḥ·tāh lih·yō·wṯ lōw lə·’iš·šāh ’a·ḥă·rê ’ă·šer huṭ·ṭam·mā·’āh kî- ṯō·w·‘ê·ḇāh hî lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·lō ṯa·ḥă·ṭî ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lə·ḵā na·ḥă·lāh
verses.literal: then the husband who divorced her first may not remarry . . . . . . her after she has been defiled for that is an abomination to the LORD You must not bring sin upon the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יִקַּ֥ח אִישׁ֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה חֲדָשָׁ֔ה לֹ֤א יֵצֵא֙ בַּצָּבָ֔א וְלֹא־ יַעֲבֹ֥ר עָלָ֖יו לְכָל־ דָּבָ֑ר נָקִ֞י יִהְיֶ֤ה לְבֵיתוֹ֙ שָׁנָ֣ה אֶחָ֔ת וְשִׂמַּ֖ח אֶת־ אִשְׁתּ֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ לָקָֽח׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî- yiq·qaḥ ’îš ’iš·šāh ḥă·ḏā·šāh lō yê·ṣê baṣ·ṣā·ḇā wə·lō- ya·‘ă·ḇōr ‘ā·lāw lə·ḵāl dā·ḇār nā·qî yih·yeh lə·ḇê·ṯōw šā·nāh ’e·ḥāṯ wə·śim·maḥ ’eṯ- ’iš·tōw ’ă·šer- lā·qāḥ
verses.literal: If a man is newly married . . . he must not be sent to war or be pressed into any duty For one year he is free to stay at home and bring joy to the wife he has married

verses.original: לֹא־ יַחֲבֹ֥ל רֵחַ֖יִם וָרָ֑כֶב כִּי־ נֶ֖פֶשׁ ה֥וּא חֹבֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō- ya·ḥă·ḇōl rê·ḥa·yim wā·rā·ḵeḇ kî- ne·p̄eš hū ḥō·ḇêl
verses.literal: Do not take a pair of millstones or even an upper millstone as security for a debt because that would be taking one’s livelihood as security

verses.original: כִּי־ יִמָּצֵ֣א אִ֗ישׁ גֹּנֵ֨ב נֶ֤פֶשׁ מֵאֶחָיו֙ מִבְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהִתְעַמֶּר־ בּ֖וֹ וּמְכָר֑וֹ וּמֵת֙ הַגַּנָּ֣ב הַה֔וּא וּבִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָרָ֖ע מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yim·mā·ṣê ’îš gō·nêḇ ne·p̄eš mê·’e·ḥāw mib·bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·hiṯ·‘am·mer- bōw ū·mə·ḵā·rōw ū·mêṯ hag·gan·nāḇ ha·hū ū·ḇi·‘ar·tā hā·rā‘ miq·qir·be·ḵā
verses.literal: If a man is caught kidnapping one of his Israelite . . . brothers whether he treats him as a slave or sells him the kidnapper must die So you must purge the evil from among you

verses.original: הִשָּׁ֧מֶר בְּנֶֽגַע־ הַצָּרַ֛עַת לִשְׁמֹ֥ר מְאֹ֖ד וְלַעֲשׂ֑וֹת כְּכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁר־ יוֹר֨וּ אֶתְכֶ֜ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים הַלְוִיִּ֛ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתִ֖ם תִּשְׁמְר֥וּ לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: hiš·šā·mer bə·ne·ḡa‘- haṣ·ṣā·ra·‘aṯ liš·mōr mə·’ōḏ wə·la·‘ă·śō·wṯ kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- yō·w·rū ’eṯ·ḵem hak·kō·hă·nîm hal·wî·yim ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯim tiš·mə·rū la·‘ă·śō·wṯ
verses.literal: In cases of infectious skin diseases be careful to diligently follow . . . everything the Levitical priests instruct you Be careful to do as I have commanded them

verses.original: זָכ֕וֹר אֵ֧ת אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לְמִרְיָ֑ם בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ בְּצֵאתְכֶ֥ם מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: zā·ḵō·wr ’êṯ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lə·mir·yām bad·de·reḵ bə·ṣê·ṯə·ḵem mim·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam on the journey after you came out of Egypt

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תַשֶּׁ֥ה בְרֵֽעֲךָ מַשַּׁ֣את מְא֑וּמָה לֹא־ תָבֹ֥א אֶל־ בֵּית֖וֹ לַעֲבֹ֥ט עֲבֹטֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯaš·šeh ḇə·rē·ʿă·ḵå̄ maš·šaṯ mə·’ū·māh lō- ṯā·ḇō ’el- bê·ṯōw la·‘ă·ḇōṭ ‘ă·ḇō·ṭōw
verses.literal: When you lend anything . . . to your neighbor do not enter . . . his house to collect security

verses.original: בַּח֖וּץ תַּעֲמֹ֑ד וְהָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ נֹשֶׁ֣ה ב֔וֹ יוֹצִ֥יא אֵלֶ֛יךָ אֶֽת־ הַעֲב֖וֹט הַחֽוּצָה׃
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥūṣ ta·‘ă·mōḏ wə·hā·’îš ’ă·šer ’at·tāh nō·šeh ḇōw yō·w·ṣî ’ê·le·ḵā ’eṯ- ha·‘ă·ḇō·wṭ ha·ḥū·ṣāh
verses.literal: You are to stand outside while the man to whom you are lending brings the security out to you

verses.original: וְאִם־ אִ֥ישׁ עָנִ֖י ה֑וּא לֹ֥א תִשְׁכַּ֖ב בַּעֲבֹטֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ’îš ‘ā·nî hū lō ṯiš·kaḇ ba·‘ă·ḇō·ṭōw
verses.literal: If he is a poor man you must not go to sleep with the security in your possession

verses.original: הָשֵׁב֩ תָּשִׁ֨יב ל֤וֹ אֶֽת־ הַעֲבוֹט֙ כְּבֹ֣א הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ וְשָׁכַ֥ב בְּשַׂלְמָת֖וֹ וּבֵֽרֲכֶ֑ךָּ וּלְךָ֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה צְדָקָ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: hā·šêḇ tā·šîḇ lōw ’eṯ- ha·‘ă·ḇō·wṭ kə·ḇō haš·še·meš wə·šā·ḵaḇ bə·śal·mā·ṯōw ū·ḇê·ră·ḵe·kā ū·lə·ḵā tih·yeh ṣə·ḏā·qāh lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: be sure to return . . . it to him by sunset . . . so that he may sleep in his own cloak and bless you and this will be credited to you as righteousness . . . before the LORD your God

verses.original: לֹא־ תַעֲשֹׁ֥ק שָׂכִ֖יר עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְי֑וֹן מֵאַחֶ֕יךָ א֧וֹ מִגֵּרְךָ֛ אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּאַרְצְךָ֖ בִּשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯa·‘ă·šōq śā·ḵîr ‘ā·nî wə·’eḇ·yō·wn mê·’a·ḥe·ḵā ’ōw mig·gê·rə·ḵā ’ă·šer bə·’ar·ṣə·ḵā biš·‘ā·re·ḵā
verses.literal: Do not oppress a hired hand who is poor and needy whether he is a brother or a foreigner residing in one of your towns

verses.original: בְּיוֹמוֹ֩ תִתֵּ֨ן שְׂכָר֜וֹ וְֽלֹא־ תָב֧וֹא עָלָ֣יו הַשֶּׁ֗מֶשׁ כִּ֤י עָנִי֙ ה֔וּא וְאֵלָ֕יו ה֥וּא נֹשֵׂ֖א אֶת־ נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־ יִקְרָ֤א עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה וְהָיָ֥ה בְךָ֖ חֵֽטְא׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·yō·w·mōw ṯit·tên śə·ḵā·rōw wə·lō- ṯā·ḇō·w ‘ā·lāw haš·še·meš kî ‘ā·nî hū wə·’ê·lāw hū nō·śê ’eṯ- nap̄·šōw wə·lō- yiq·rā ‘ā·le·ḵā ’el- Yah·weh wə·hā·yāh ḇə·ḵā ḥêṭ
verses.literal: You are to pay his wages each day before sunset . . . because he . . . . . . is poor and depends - on them Otherwise he may cry out to the LORD against you . . . and you will be guilty of sin

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יוּמְת֤וּ אָבוֹת֙ עַל־ בָּנִ֔ים וּבָנִ֖ים לֹא־ יוּמְת֣וּ עַל־ אָב֑וֹת אִ֥יש בְּחֶטְא֖וֹ יוּמָֽתוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō- yū·mə·ṯū ’ā·ḇō·wṯ ‘al- bā·nîm ū·ḇā·nîm lō- yū·mə·ṯū ‘al- ’ā·ḇō·wṯ ʾīš bə·ḥeṭ·’ōw yū·mā·ṯū
verses.literal: Fathers shall not be put to death for their children nor children . . . for their fathers each is to die for his own sin

verses.original: לֹ֣א תַטֶּ֔ה מִשְׁפַּ֖ט גֵּ֣ר יָת֑וֹם וְלֹ֣א תַחֲבֹ֔ל בֶּ֖גֶד אַלְמָנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lō ṯaṭ·ṭeh miš·paṭ gêr yā·ṯō·wm wə·lō ṯa·ḥă·ḇōl be·ḡeḏ ’al·mā·nāh
verses.literal: Do not deny justice to the foreigner or the fatherless and do not take a widow’s cloak as security

verses.original: וְזָכַרְתָּ֗ כִּ֣י עֶ֤בֶד הָיִ֙יתָ֙ בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם וַֽיִּפְדְּךָ֛ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מִשָּׁ֑ם עַל־ כֵּ֞ן אָנֹכִ֤י מְצַוְּךָ֙ לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·zā·ḵar·tā kî ‘e·ḇeḏ hā·yî·ṯā bə·miṣ·ra·yim way·yip̄·də·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā miš·šām ‘al- kên ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh
verses.literal: Remember that you were slaves in Egypt and the LORD your God redeemed you from that place Therefore . . . I am commanding you to do - this

verses.original: כִּ֣י תִקְצֹר֩ קְצִֽירְךָ֨ בְשָׂדֶ֜ךָ וְשָֽׁכַחְתָּ֧ עֹ֣מֶר בַּשָּׂדֶ֗ה לֹ֤א תָשׁוּב֙ לְקַחְתּ֔וֹ לַגֵּ֛ר לַיָּת֥וֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֑ה לְמַ֤עַן יְבָרֶכְךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּכֹ֖ל מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṯiq·ṣōr qə·ṣî·rə·ḵā ḇə·śā·ḏe·ḵā wə·šā·ḵaḥ·tā ‘ō·mer baś·śā·ḏeh lō ṯā·šūḇ lə·qaḥ·tōw lag·gêr lay·yā·ṯō·wm wə·lā·’al·mā·nāh yih·yeh lə·ma·‘an yə·ḇā·reḵ·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bə·ḵōl ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: If you are harvesting . . . in your field and forget a sheaf there do not go back to get it It is to be left for the foreigner the fatherless and the widow so that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hands

verses.original: כִּ֤י תַחְבֹּט֙ זֵֽיתְךָ֔ לֹ֥א תְפָאֵ֖ר אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ לַגֵּ֛ר לַיָּת֥וֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָ֖ה יִהְיֶֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ṯaḥ·bōṭ zê·ṯə·ḵā lō ṯə·p̄ā·’êr ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā lag·gêr lay·yā·ṯō·wm wə·lā·’al·mā·nāh yih·yeh
verses.literal: When you beat the olives from your trees you must not go over the branches again What remains will be for the foreigner the fatherless and the widow

verses.original: כִּ֤י תִבְצֹר֙ כַּרְמְךָ֔ לֹ֥א תְעוֹלֵ֖ל אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ לַגֵּ֛ר לַיָּת֥וֹם וְלָאַלְמָנָ֖ה יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṯiḇ·ṣōr kar·mə·ḵā lō ṯə·‘ō·w·lêl ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā lag·gêr lay·yā·ṯō·wm wə·lā·’al·mā·nāh yih·yeh
verses.literal: When you gather the grapes of your vineyard you must not go over the vines again What remains will be for the foreigner the fatherless and the widow

verses.original: וְזָ֣כַרְתָּ֔ כִּי־ עֶ֥בֶד הָיִ֖יתָ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם עַל־ כֵּ֞ן אָנֹכִ֤י מְצַוְּךָ֙ לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·zā·ḵar·tā kî- ‘e·ḇeḏ hā·yî·ṯā bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim ‘al- kên ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh
verses.literal: Remember that you were slaves in the land of Egypt Therefore . . . I am commanding you to do - this
